t: This DEWALT TSTAK 2.0 tool box provides robust and secure storage for tools and equipment, essential for any busy trade professional. Constructed from durable polypropylene, this impact-resistant tool box is ideal for transporting gear between different jobsites or for organised workshop storage. The hinged lid features strong metal clamps and metal pin side latches to keep contents secure, while an IP54 rating offers protection against water and dust ingress. With a 30kg maximum load capacity and integrated carrying handles, it is designed for heavy-duty use. The TSTAK 2.0 system compatibility allows for stacking and customisation with other TSTAK modules, alongside a built-in fixing point for the DEWALT tracker (not supplied).
